name: The Sunk Cost Fallacy
definition: Unrecoverable past expenditure is used to justify a choice despite unfavorable future costs and benefits.
boundary: Past costs are sunk only if unrecoverable; distinguish salvage value and future contractual consequences.

source_variants.name: Sunk Cost Fallacy (Batık maliyet yanılgısı)
source_variants.definition: Keeping an indefensible position because of past investment.
source_variants.coverage_reason: No named mechanism, required state or observation model is implemented in the original Mesa sample.
